verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the southern end of the resort enclave of Cap Cana.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the southern end of the resort enclave of Cap Cana

verified_facts.text: The Jack Nicklaus Punta Espada golf course surrounds the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: The dazzling Jack Nicklaus, 7.396-yard Punta Espada golf course in Punta Cana that surrounds our resort

verified_facts.text: The golf course is located steps from the lobby.

verified_facts.text: Nina's menu was created in collaboration with chef Diego Munoz.

verified_facts.text: Nina has an organic wine list.

verified_facts.text: The Amber Room cigar bar is run in partnership with Arturo Fuente.
verified_facts.excerpt: In partnership with Arturo Fuente, our Cap Cana cigar bar in Dominican Republic offers an intimate retreat

verified_facts.text: In the Amber Room a cigar sommelier selects a cigar and a rummelier pairs it with rum.
verified_facts.excerpt: a cigar sommelier will select a special roll for you and a “rummelier” will pair it with two fingers of the Caribbean spirit

verified_facts.text: Cassava is the all-day restaurant, with greenery-filled ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: At CASSAVA, our signature all-day restaurant in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, soaring greenery-filled ceilings set the stage

verified_facts.text: Cassava is inspired by Dominican and Latin Caribbean cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: inspired by the rich culinary heritage of Dominican and Latin Caribbean cuisine

verified_facts.text: Cielo Mio rooftop bar serves tiki-style drinks with a Mexican twist.
verified_facts.excerpt: For rooftop views, Cielo Mio serves tiki-style drinks with a Mexican twist

verified_facts.text: Marola serves Mediterranean flavors and wood-fired pizzas by the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Marola tempts with Mediterranean flavors and wood-fired pizzas by the sea

verified_facts.text: Kawa is a coffee and chocolate shop focused on Dominican coffee and cacao.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sensory journey through heritage of Dominican coffee and cacao craftsmanship.

verified_facts.text: Carey Bay Beach Bar serves beachfront seafood inspired by Caribbean fish shacks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beachfront seafood and island spirit, inspired by Caribbean fish shacks.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar blends St. Regis luxury with Asian-inspired flavor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our signature Punta Cana bar, blending St. Regis luxury with Asian-inspired flavor.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar serves a Damajuana cocktail highlighting the Dominican spiced drink mamajuana.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Damajuana, which highlights the Dominican spiced drink mamajuana

verified_facts.text: Both the St. Regis Bar and Nina take reservations from the general public.
verified_facts.excerpt: Both the St. Regis Bar and Nina are open to the general public for reservations.

verified_facts.text: The Uma Wine Cellar Room in Nina can be reserved for wine tastings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wine enthusiasts can reserve the Uma Wine Cellar Room in Nina for wine tastings.

verified_facts.text: Chapi Design and architectural firm Acebal Canney designed the resort to honor the characteristics of the Dominican Republic.
verified_facts.excerpt: the architectural firm Acebal Canney were enlisted to create a sumptuous resort that honors the unique characteristics of the Dominican Republic

verified_facts.text: Local design touches include tropical plants, patterned brickwork and curved ceilings with wickerwork typical of the island.
verified_facts.excerpt: it's the local touches that ground the design: tropical plants, patterned brickwork, and curved ceilings adorned with wickerwork typical of the island

verified_facts.text: Artworks by Dominican artists are displayed throughout the building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Artworks by Dominican artists are peppered throughout the building, lending the resort a gallery-like vibe.

verified_facts.text: The reception centerpiece is a curving wood staircase in front of a cascade of water.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suspended in front of a breathtaking cascade of water is the centerpiece of the reception area: a dramatic curving wood staircase

verified_facts.text: The resort is St. Regis's first in the Dominican Republic.
verified_facts.excerpt: The luxury brand's first foray in the Dominican Republic

verified_facts.text: The resort has a private beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: with its manicured landscaping, placid pools, and a private beach

verified_facts.text: There is a pool on the green roof, with the Cielo Mio tiki bar at the rooftop pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: If you’re at the rooftop pool, you can dine and eat at the modern tiki bar Cielo Mio.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Frette sheets and robes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Frette sheets and robes

verified_facts.text: Some rooms have swim-out pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: and some have swim out pools

verified_facts.text: Rooms are decorated in colors that evoke the sand and sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: decorated in colors that evoke the sand and sea

verified_facts.text: Butlers are on call, including by WhatsApp, and can arrange tennis lessons, boat excursions and horseback riding.
verified_facts.excerpt: Butlers are on call (and WhatsApp) for your every whim and can arrange tennis lessons, boat excursions, and horseback riding.

verified_facts.text: Couples can book spa treatments in rooms with their own terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Couples can book treatments in rooms that have their own terraces for the ultimate private indulgence.

verified_facts.text: The spa has separate men's and women's areas with indoor and outdoor lounges, hot and cold baths, steam rooms and saunas.
verified_facts.excerpt: separate men’s and women’s areas with indoor and outdoor lounges, hot and cold baths, steam rooms, and saunas

verified_facts.text: The complimentary kids club is designed for children ages 4 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: Thoughtfully designed for children ages 4 to 12.

verified_facts.text: The kids' and teens' center has toys, video games and a movie nook, plus a separate room for teens.
verified_facts.excerpt: there’s a kids’ and teens’ center complete with toys, video games, and a cozy nook for movie watching

verified_facts.text: Tennis courts and a marina for snorkeling expeditions are a short drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: A short drive away are tennis courts and a marina from which to embark on snorkeling expeditions.

verified_facts.text: Punta Cana International Airport (PUJ) is about 15 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: PUJ is located approximately 15.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle; private transportation can be reserved for a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is fully cashless.
verified_facts.excerpt: our hotel operates as a fully cashless property

verified_facts.text: The resort is not all-inclusive.
verified_facts.excerpt: Know that it’s not an all-inclusive stay, so be prepared.

verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, pets are welcome at The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort. One pet is allowed per room

verified_facts.excerpt: the St. Regis is under the umbrella of the Cap Cana Foundation, which oversees the protection and preservation of marine and land wildlife and their habitats
